description: Get a project's test states and roles. A state is a named set of facts about one account set's data that tests start from and leave, each fact scoped to the account set or account-wide, with a quick read-only check. A role is a kind of account a test acts as, CREATED by Muggle or SUPPLIED by the customer. Also returns freshAccountSetStateId (the state a newly formed account set starts in) and parallelAccountSetLimit; a project with none saved returns an empty catalog. Response shape: { projectId, states: [{ id, name, facts: [{ statement, scope, roleId }], check }], roles: [{ id, name, source, allowsChanges }], freshAccountSetStateId, parallelAccountSetLimit, updatedAt }.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) that owns the test states and roles

name: muggle-remote-test-chaining-catalog-get
